properties.description: Run by pages.yml when the site is published. It reads the design committed at each vX.Y.Z tag, keeping one tag per ISO week plus the latest. It reads both layouts: docs/design/reflow2.json up to 0.78.0, and one file per record from 0.79.0, through git cat-file --batch. It writes records, links, decisions, requirements, checks and changes, and the kinds of each. Release manifests (INCLUDES) are counted apart as manifest_links. A tag holding no readable design is named in `skipped`, never counted as empty. About 8 seconds over reflow2's 97 tags.
properties.name: tools/site_counts.py — counts reflow2's own design at each release tag for the home page (site/counts.json)
